title: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
titleRomaji: Kimi ga Iu ni wa Inu no Koi
synopsis: "I just want to live my life listening to someone's orders and being praised..." Is that a sinful, unrealistic dream? Yet, that was the sole wish of ordinary high school student Akira Tamanoi. Days without dreams or motivation... One day, as punishment for being late, Akira is assigned to help the student council and meets the intelligent and beautiful student council president, Makoto Miyauchi. And then, something unexpected happens. Miyauchi constantly asks Akira for favors. "Please... thank you!" "You can't do it? You did well!" Without understanding the meaning of the comfort given to him by Miyauchi, Akira becomes completely engrossed in this suddenly realized dream... There he was, my wonderful master. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Teto X Egen
synopsis: Ha-Seon, a “workaholic” for whom her company and job are her whole life, and Seon-Ho, a “homebody” whose world consists only of his home and his cat. These two seemed as unlikely to cross paths as parallel lines. But not only are they assigned to the same task force, it turns out they’re actually neighbors, and their daily lives begin to get tangled up. Just when things are getting complicated, Seon-Ho’s first love shows up…! What will become of this precarious yet strangely thrilling relationship between two people who lived in completely different worlds? (Source: Millie, translated)

title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleRomaji: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleNative: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
synonyms: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
synopsis: On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side (Source: Yen Press)

As he defeats nearby small animals with his chosen skills and newly learned magic to grind levels, he makes an incredible discovery: his moss form can evolve into other species. title: Gizmorizer
synopsis: In the towering kingdom of Urunaria, society is literally built on inequality. The wealthiest reside at the top, while the poor are confined to the dark, crumbling depths below. For Kuro, a young slave raised by his uncle in the lowest levels, life offers no future - only labor, loss, and silence. But when his uncle is executed by the state, Kuro inherits a mysterious device: Gizmo - a pair of mechanical gloves with the power to grip, scale, and defy the very system built to crush him. Armed with nothing but this outlawed tool and his burning desire for freedom, Kuro begins his ascent, both up the tower and against a society that deems him worthless. (Source: Titan Manga)
